minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed a three-lot ANR on Lemster Road/Kilburn Street and continued two Sunny Hill storm water hearings to Feb 26.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan creating three lots after discussion of an existing driveway easement and a possible lot-merger question on an adjoining parcel. It approved a de minimis erosion control change at 274 Prospect Street and continued two Sunny Hill Road storm water hearings to February 26. It also discussed a policy on advance notice of continuance requests, heard a capital plan discussion touching Turkey Hill, and took committee reports.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted 4-0 by roll call to endorse an ANR plan creating three lots on Lemster Road and Kilburn Street.
The board voted 4-0 to approve a silt fence relocation at 274 Prospect Street as a de minimis change to an erosion control plan.
Two Sunny Hill Road storm water hearings, at 255 and at 317-321, were each continued 4-0 to February 26 at 6:05 p.m.
The 255 Sunny Hill Road applicant must say by February 20 whether it will ask for another continuance.
The chair will bring draft wording on a policy for advance notice of continuance requests to the next meeting for review and a possible vote.

why_it_matters: The three-lot endorsement and the Sunny Hill Road storm water hearings decide how land is divided and how runoff is managed near existing neighborhoods, and the hearings stay open until at least February 26.
A continuance-notice policy would set how much warning applicants must give before delaying a hearing, which affects how long abutters wait for a decision.
Members discussed capital requests for the next ten years, including the old school building and Turkey Hill, which are the kind of items residents are later asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
watch_next: February 20: deadline for the 255 Sunny Hill Road applicant to say whether it will request another continuance.
February 26 at 6:05 p.m.: both Sunny Hill Road storm water hearings resume, and the chair's draft continuance-notice policy is due at the next meeting.
